mapper.select: SELECT id, name, password_hash AS pass, stamps, role, auth_epoch FROM t_user ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, password_hash AS pass, stamps, role, auth_epoch FROM t_user ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user (id, name, password_hash, stamps, role, auth_epoch) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{pass}, COALESCE(#{stamps}, 0), #{role}, #{authEpoch})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET name = #{name}, password_hash = #{pass}, stamps = #{stamps}, role = #{role}, auth_epoch = #{authEpoch} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_order SET order_table = NULL WHERE user_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, password_hash AS pass, role, stamps, auth_epoch FROM t_user WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
